newsitem.title: USA: Rymer files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Rymer files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: Rymer Foods Inc, a frozen meat company, said Tuesday it has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in order to implement a prepackaged bankruptcy restructuring plan.
Under the plan, Rymer will implement a 25-1 reverse stock split and will eliminate all senior notes.

Under the plan, prior senior note holders will own 80 percent of the common shares oustanding of the company, prior shareholders will own 10 percent and senior management will own 10 percent, Rymer said.

Rymer's shareholders and note holders have approved the plan, Rymer said, adding that its main operating subsidiary, Rymer Meat Inc, is not part of the bankruptcy filing and that its operations will not be affected.
Rymer said it expected to receive approval of the plan and complete a previously announced financial restructuring in late August.
Rymer previously completed a bankruptcy reorganization in 1993.
